caption:
Everyone wants more five-star reviews.

A great review earns the call. It doesn't win the job. The business that answers first usually does.

Most service businesses take over an hour to respond to a new lead. Reply within minutes and you close more jobs.

Try this: have a friend text or call your top three competitors at the same time, same day. Clock who replies first. That's the business actually winning, star count aside.

Run the numbers on your own response process.

DM TOOLS

#ServiceBusiness #SpeedToLead #LeadResponse #LocalMarketing #ContractorMarketing
rationale: Fills the under-served Contrarian/POV slot with a sharp, unclaimed reframe (reviews earn the call, speed wins the job) distinct from every prior speed/employee/leads-vs-jobs/tagline/calendar/reactivation POV already shipped, in the reel format research confirms wins cold-audience reach for bold-claim B2B hooks.
